what: One Crosstrainer session, protocol NN_HFL_WITH_DP, 2 clients (Site A and Site B), 3 iterations, 2 local epochs per iteration, each client reading its own silo bucket. The scored model is the highest-iteration aggregated global model.

target.metric: AUROC of the final global model on the frozen test days, per site and label (A:congestion, A:mobility, B:congestion, B:mobility)
target.direction: every one of the four values at or above 0.97

also.metric: fraction of true events warned at least 60 minutes ahead, for the rare family at each site (A:mobility, B:congestion)

target.metric: epsilon of the DP-SGD run that executes, counting real optimizer steps (per client, delta = n^-2)
target.direction: at or below 1.0; recorded as a number together with delta and the noise multiplier
target.note: privacy_budget() is set to 1.0. The base-class accountant counts each local epoch as one step; model.py overrides _compute_privacy_budget to count the real steps (n_local_epochs x iterations x ceil(n / batch_size)).

grader: ran-fl/aws/eval_job.py (deterministic script, no model; AUROC, validation-tuned F1, 60-minute lead recall)
